scope: Actual game functions in a unit DOM adapter. Explicit enemy/equipment/clock fixtures. Not browser, phone or natural-play evidence.

cases.name: six EVO prerequisites and mutual exclusion are actual legal choices
piercebeam immediately damages a whole line including beyond basic range
hunter swarm produces more actual homing fire and damage than basic drones
chainstorm reaches the far second target and actually interrupts movement
meteor barrage launches four sequential missiles and causes greater real area damage
spiralsaw hits outside the old orbit and extends real pickup attraction
reactive aegis blocks, damages nearby enemies and recharges earlier
thunderhive consumes two full weapons, frees a slot and deals its own combat damage
blastwheel consumes two full weapons, frees a slot and deals its own combat damage
a single-weapon evolution prevents later double-weapon fusion
all four low-level synergies cause real damage or shielding
lock, lens, capacitor, cooler, magnet and armor have actual passive effects
latched experience catches a continuously moving ship and never vanishes on an upgrade
elites and bosses remain real pursuing entities beyond the ordinary culling boundary
a legal maximized build keeps entities, shots, chains and pixel effects bounded
